Interface ScoringStrategy

All Known Implementing Classes:
PerfectBonusScoringStrategy, StandardScoringStrategy
public interface ScoringStrategy
Strategy interface for evaluating recognition accuracy and computing scores.

Implementations define whether an accuracy threshold is met and how points are calculated from recognition results.

      accuracy - a normalized confidence score (typically 0–1)

      true if the accuracy is sufficient to pass

    • calculateScore

      int calculateScore(double accuracy, int tier)
      Calculates the base score for a single attempt.

      Formula: floor(accuracy × 100) × tier

      Parameters:
      accuracy - normalized confidence score
      tier - difficulty tier (typically 1–5)
      Returns:
      points earned for this attempt
